info.title: tldes.com Domain Pricing API
info.description: Domain pricing data from 100+ registrars: registration, renewal and transfer prices, promos and registrar metadata. Updated hourly. Full documentation: https://tldes.com/docs/api-reference.html

get.description: Single endpoint; the `data` parameter selects what to return. Endpoints marked as protected require the `key` parameter.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: What to return. Free (no key): status, registrars, demo. Key required: prices, promos, promospecial, meta, keyinfo.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: API key. Required for prices, promos, promospecial, meta, keyinfo.

parameters.name: registrars
parameters.description: Comma-separated registrar names (e.g. dynadot.com,porkbun.com). Applies to data=prices, data=promos, data=promospecial; ignored elsewhere. Unknown names are silently ignored. Can be combined with tlds.

parameters.name: tlds
parameters.description: Comma-separated TLDs without dot (e.g. com,net). Applies to data=prices, data=promos, data=promospecial; ignored elsewhere. Registrars with no matching TLDs are omitted. Can be combined with registrars.

200.description: Requested data. Shape depends on the data parameter. data=prices: {updated, totalRegistrars, registrars: [{name, ts, currency, ICANNfee, prices: [[tld, registration, renewal, transfer], ...]}]} — all four tuple values are strings, prices are in the registrar's currency. data=promos and data=promospecial: {updated, registrars: {name: {currency, ICANNfee, promos: [[type, tld, price, code, limit, newUsersOnly], ...]}}} where type is 0=registration, 1=renewal, 2=transfer; promospecial adds a strings array and a 7th tuple element with an index into it. data=registrars: a plain JSON array of registrar names. data=status: {updated}. data=keyinfo: {keyValidUntil}. data=meta: registrar metadata and currency rates.

schema.description: See the data parameter description and https://tldes.com/docs/api-reference.html for exact shapes

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key
